caption: The drawing depicts a single metal candle holder placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The candle holder consists of a round, shallow base or tray that is metallic gray in color, with a slightly raised rim. Resting vertically on the tray is a cylindrical shaft that serves as the main support for the candle. On top of the shaft is a short, partially melted white candle with a blackened wick, which has wax drippings running down its sides and pooling around the base of the shaft. Attached to the side of the shaft is a small horizontal handle. Additionally, on the tray beside the shaft is a large circular finger loop or handle, also metallic in appearance, designed for carrying the candle holder. The drawing uses subtle shading and variations in tone to give a realistic effect to the depiction of metallic and wax surfaces.
title: Candlestick
